verdict.rationale: GitHub feature list explicitly confirms pre-request scripting ('Snippets of code... executed before the request is sent'), and the AI-features doc mentions 'scripting capabilities for pre-request logic and test cases', implying post-response test scripts exist too. However, no dedicated documentation details post-response script syntax, variable-setting APIs, or examples of chaining/massaging data across requests. missing for 10: explicit post-response/test-script documentation, examples of setting/reading environment variables between chained requests, independent hands-on confirmation of scripting workflow.
